# Golden entities

Copied verbatim from `AbsaOSS/living-doc-utilities` `tests/fixtures/golden/` at tag `v0.6.0`
(commit `80378738a52f57452374f5645912d254ea1f5b09`). Do not edit here: re-copy from the `utilities`
tag this repository pins.

- `gherkin/` and `pageobject/` are the source-code inputs; `tests/doc_source/test_golden_entities.py`
  runs them through the full `doc-source` collector.
- `gh-issues/` and `expected/` are the issue-body inputs and their hand-written entities, kept for the
  `doc-issues` port (PLANNED after v0.1.0).
